verdict.rationale: Okta is an identity SaaS, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only shows an open-source MCP server that lets external LLMs and agents run Okta admin operations in natural language. That is an integration for outside agents, not an assistant built into the Okta product. No evidence describes a native assistant users can delegate tasks to inside Okta, so this is adjacent support and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
